items.title: D3 orchestration and fault matrix reviewed
evidence: D3 design + fault-matrix.yaml 18 cases (F, D3-R, D3-N)
Temporal dev slice 10/10; D3-N02-N05 database-side interleavings measured
D3-N01 executed twice over: internal/relay/lease_crash_test.go SIGKILLs a real relay mid-content_shred and separately fails every delete (2026-11-02)
D3-N06 obligation half executed: internal/relay/suspended_obligations_test.go runs the retention sweeps and the relay against an operator-suspended org (2026-11-02)

D3-N02 shared-reference hold-back guarded from both directions: internal/relay/shared_ref_shred_pg_test.go requires the expiry sweep to deliver nothing while another live input or a published artifact version names the same bytes and to deliver the reference exactly once when the last holder goes, and internal/api/shared_ref_delete_pg_test.go covers the delete path's two holder checks plus the always-written hand-off row that carries an empty reference list (2026-11-02)

D4-a executed live 2026-11-04: suspension refused new submits at the DB (submit_task -> org_execution_unavailable, no new run row), create_audit_export -> org_operator_suspended, expire_due_inputs ran (=1) and directory sync ran (result=success) while the org was suspended without clearing operator_suspended; restoration needed the four-step ack protocol and an unacknowledged restore kept work.org closed
items.note: U3 nine commitments answered yes on 2026-10-27; resources approved; drills staffed by 5 dev/test people. Remaining: four C22 drills, the D3-N06 operator entry point plus projection-sync continuity under suspension, and the 11-15/16 drill itself with SRE present. D3-N03 is covered by cmd/work-export/lease_crash_test.go (2026-11-02): takeover only after the lease ages out, the stale worker is refused by complete and fail, exactly one completed audit row, zero download tickets. The first version failed the required Work R0a gates because the package lacked the TestMain that calls testpg.EnsureFixtures, so the roles existed on a developer machine but not on a fresh CI Postgres; the harness was fixed the same way as internal/api and cmd/work-provider-setup, and the required Work R0a gates run green for that fix (commit 1ffe0f6af, 2026-11-02), so N03 now counts as executed evidence. D3-N01 is now executed the same way (internal/relay/lease_crash_test.go, 2026-11-02, rewritten the same day to use a real content_shred event instead of a generic task row): a second OS process runs the real relay against a real content.Local store and is SIGKILLed between the two references of one shred row, and the parent asserts the live lease blocks a replica, a replica claims only after claimed_until ages out, the re-delivery re-deletes the already-gone object and still acks exactly once with no dead letter, no later pass claims anything, and the soft-deleted task keeps its deleted_at and state throughout. The same file covers the 清理失败 half of the row: a store whose every delete fails releases the lease, records content_delete_failed with a backoffed retry, removes no content, leaves the task deleted, and the retry then delivers without queueing a new event. The idempotency claim is mutation-checked, not assumed - dropping errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) from content.Local.Delete makes the takeover pass stop at attempts=1 with content_delete_failed and no delivery, so a crash mid-shred would wedge the row through ten backoffs and dead-letter it with content still on disk; the case fails in that state and was reverted afterwards. Both cases need WORK_TEST_PG_URL, which the Work R0a gates job sets before go test ./..., so they run in CI and not only on a developer machine. D3-N06 now has an executable case on each of its two halves: the refusing side is migration 0026 with internal/api/audit_export_gate_pg_test.go (a suspended org gets 409 org_operator_suspended, a disabled or archived org 403 org_execution_unavailable, a replayed client_request_id still returns 202 with the same id, and the admin read surface stays 200), and the obligation side is internal/relay/suspended_obligations_test.go, which pins the two design properties 「kill switch 不停 relay」 and 「停用不取消清理」: with operator_suspended on and execution_enabled off, expire_due_inputs and shred_due_audit_exports each sweep exactly one due object, the two content_shred rows they enqueue are all delivered by a real relay over a real content store, the not-yet-due input is left untouched, and neither the sweep nor the delivery clears the switch. What is still missing for N06 is the operational entry point (operator_suspended is written by R0b's work.apply_execution_entitlement, not by anything in R0a), projection-sync continuity during suspension - the database side is already pinned positively by internal/directory/pg_test.go:544, which syncs an operator-suspended org across two revisions and keeps the flag, while the Temporal-scheduled pass during a suspension is not - and the staffed drill itself, so C03 stays partial. 2026-11-04 补：D3-N06 的**运维入口那一半今天在活机上走过一次**（SQL `work.apply_execution_entitlement`，工单号进账本），并当场证伪两处旧写法——①「解除开关」不是一步而是四步 ack 协议，未确认时提新 revision 直接 `governance_revision_conflict`（P5 的第一次活体证据）；② P6 的「以授权角色经 psql 调」成立，但主机上没有 work_operator 登录通道（无 `_login` 变体、无 operator env），本轮以 superuser `SET ROLE` 进入，值班可用的 DSN 仍未 provision（#56-B）。另 `cancellation_intent` 全仓无消费者（本轮实测两条 pending、attempts=0）。C03 仍 partial：11-15/16 整窗与 DR2 签收未做。 2026-11-04 深夜补两半：① D3-N06 的运维入口已在活机走过一次（`apply_execution_entitlement` 四步 ack 协议，见演练单 D4-6a／6c）；②「投影同步在停用期间的连续性」按**部署真实形态**已验：驱动投影同步的是 systemd `work-directory-sync.service`（10 分钟 timer）而**不是 Temporal Schedule**，本轮在停用态与关闭态各跑一次均 `result=success` 且没清掉 operator／execution 标志（D4-a 3d 与 C28-4b）。所以这条待办的原文「由 Temporal Schedule 实际驱动的那一轮」是一个不存在于本部署的载体，按载体写会永远闭不上——已具名更正，判据改为「按部署实际的驱动者在停用／关闭态跑通」，满足。SRE 在场与 DR2 的整窗签收仍按单人自决记。 2026-11-05 补：L-C04-03 的取消帧半按 A 案闭合——R0a 不发协议级取消帧（Go 侧父子管道无实现面），D4 §6.5 预算行、§6.6 第 1 条与故障矩阵 PR-05 三处已就地改述为「revoke 片段＋片段 4m 退出期限＋Temporal 超时与对账接管」，与已签 D4-09 同向，重开条件＝R0b 真子进程 broker 落地。C03 余下仍等 11-15/16 整窗与未发布代码的日志重扫。

items.note: No real sandbox/egress/provider. D-08b (gateway credential/KMS) is a DR0 sign-off and does not close C04; C04 still needs DR2 review.。2026-11-04 DR2 评审已开完（个体开发者自审：评审人＝作者＝John 一人，本记录不得被引用为"独立评审"，只可引用为逐条取证自审＋11-08 复评）。判据只用 D4 §13 八条原文，逐条标 DESIGN/SHIPPED/HOST 三层，**设计资产不计入闭合**。结论：**3 MET、1 MET 但子项过期（价表版本已被 D-08 淘汰）、3 PARTIAL、1 NOT-MET**，共 15 条发现（1 P0／8 P1／6 P2）。三条最硬：① **生产没有容器隔离**——主机无 runc/runsc/containerd/docker/podman/bubblewrap，部署代码对这些词 0 命中，子进程是同解释器裸 spawn，单元 `RestrictNamespaces=no`、能力集未裁；而 C14 只签了"不声明 gVisor"，没覆盖"连 runc 也没有"。② 更糟的是**一条 CI 绿的断言在维护这个假象**：`policy/sandbox-profile.json:3-5` 仍写 `profile=gvisor`＋`sandboxProof=true`（镜像 digest 还是 `1111…` 占位），`policy/evaluator.test.mjs:126` 用例名即"sandbox profile enforces gVisor…"，gates workflow:282 每次跑它——想如实改 profile 的人得先过一条写着 gVisor 的绿测。③ `internal/egress/doc.go:73-74` 声称"source-label checks, secret scanning, quota and price_version bookkeeping happen before Execute, in the egress request validation path"，而生产路径对这些概念的 grep 命中为 0——注释比设计文档更危险，读者会当已实现。正面结论也记：父子凭据隔离**有对手测试**（哨兵变量断进父 env、断言子进程拿不到），跨 Run/跨租户内容隔离有库侧测试，请求绑定拒绝先于消费有测试，unknown→对账在生产里真发生 21 次。**状态不置 done，也不由我翻**：等 S1（沙箱形态三选一）与 S2（P1 清单处置）落定；另需 S3（改 profile＋测试还是只加棘轮）、S4（超时 16m/15s/5s vs 实装 5s/30s/2s、且协议无取消帧）、S5（生产 env 里 WORK_STUB_* 能把真 Pi 换成 stub，加不加守卫）。"D-08b 不闭合 C04"这句仍成立，但 #49 已确认 D-08b 自身签收，故本单不再把它列为 C04 缺口。。S1/S2/S3/S5=A 已落地（2026-11-04 同日回写）：S1=A 的书面例外成文为 work-r0a-runtime-isolation-exception-2026-11-04.md（含残余风险与三条重开条件）；S3=A 已把 sandbox-profile 与 evaluator 断言改成"自证降级"，发现 2 的假控制注释（internal/egress/doc.go）同步改口；S5=A 加了 stub 拒启守卫与用例。**C04 保持 partial**（S2=A 有条件通过）：DR2 签收栏的署名仍待 John 填，8 条 L 编号遗留（L-C04-01..08）见评审记录 §7，最硬的两条是"生产没有容器隔离"与"122 条 runtime 测试没有任何 CI 跑"；S4（超时口径 16m/15s/5s vs 实装 5s/30s/2s）留作 L-C04-03，需要先有一次活机测量才能定数值。

Still open: the tenant-access org flag is not enabled, so the flag path has not been flipped on production, and no single end-to-end cutover drill has been timed. 2026-11-04 #46=A 裁定：同步按 Host `status=active` 自动置 `execution_enabled=true` 属设计意图，不加 Work 侧独立开关；试点期由 P9 的人工确认三列现值作过渡控制。实测补充：`work-directory-sync` 的 `.timer`（10min）与 `.timer-full`（每日 03:15）均 enabled+active，`work.org.revision=2` 说明链路早已生效。status 维持 partial。 2026-11-04 深夜本格演过一次并计时（关→拒 5s／开→可服务 3s，远优于 15 分钟判据），但**结论不是「可签收」**，而是把两个缺口钉实了：① **#46=A 的前提被当场证伪**——「目录同步按 Host `status=active` 自动置 `execution_enabled=true`」在代码里不存在（`record_directory_sync` 只写 `directory_sync_state`；全仓无生产代码写 `work.org` 的这三列），我在停用态真跑了一次同步，`result=success` 而标志**仍是 false**——风险方向与原判断相反：不是同步会偷偷重开租户，而是**重开没有任何自动机制**；② **租户开通／停用没有运维入口**——runbook 里 `execution_enabled` 零命中，只能以 work_owner 裸 SQL 改列，与 D3-N06 修复前的 kill switch 同一形状。status 保持 partial（试点真正需要的是 C24/C25 的组织接入，届时这两条必须已有正式入口）。
